question: What is the meaning of raw material percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process?
description: The raw material percentage in relation to the efficiency of the recycling process refers to the proportion of raw materials that are successfully recycled and reintegrated into the production cycle. This percentage is a measure of how much of the raw materials used in a building or product can be recovered and reused, thereby reducing the need for virgin materials and minimizing waste. A higher raw material percentage indicates a more efficient recycling process, as it means a greater portion of the materials can be recycled, contributing to a more sustainable and circular economy.
